structured_output.reasoning: Verdict is 'implemented' rather than 'partial' or 'contradicted' because redeemWinningTicket (Raffle.sol:L309-L346) is the sole redemption entrypoint, restricts status to NftWon or CashWon (L311-L312), and performs all redemption state changes (including any inline _settleWinningTicket at L315, winnerRecipient at L323, winnerRedeemed at L324, _burn(ticketId) at L325, prizeClaimed at L331, and winnerProceeds at L341) in the same un-caught execution frame as prize delivery. On NftWon (L329-L337), prizeToken.transferFrom(address(this), winner, deliveredPrizeTokenId) is a direct high-level call that bubbles any revert (L334), followed immediately by prizeToken.ownerOf(deliveredPrizeTokenId) != winner reverting with PrizeDeliveryVerificationFailed(winner) (L335-L337). On CashWon (L338-L343), _transferQuote(winner, cashAmount) (L342, L564-L567) reverts on protocol-sink recipients (L565) and calls quoteToken.safeTransfer (L566 -> SafeERC20.sol:L33-L37, L176-L200), which bubbles reverts and reverts with SafeERC20FailedOperation if the ERC-20 call returns false or targets an address without code. Under EVM semantics, any revert in this frame undoes the ticket burn and every state change.
